edges: The Piano Man has returned to his native Germany.
The Piano Man traveled to the United Kingdom after losing his job in Paris.
After losing his job in Paris, the man traveled to the United Kingdom through the Channel Tunnel.

In France, art dealers are obliged by law to register all purchases except those bought at a public auction.
